Medical Certificate (with valid STCW and National Expiration Dates)
Embark on an Adventure with Scripps Institution of Oceanography!

Do you have a passion for the sea and an adventurous spirit? Are you ready to support groundbreaking oceanographic research while traveling to locations across the globe? If so, we invite you to become part of our team at the Scripps Institution of Oceanography, where you will be an essential part of our mission to advance knowledge of the world's oceans and the Earth.Position: Per Diem Ship Crew Member Pool Must be able to go to sea for extended periods; typical deployments average two to three (2 - 3) months.

At the Scripps Institution of Oceanography, we are at the forefront of ocean and earth science research, education, and public service. Our institution is dedicated to exploring the mysteries of the deep and making groundbreaking discoveries. Our research covers a vast array of disciplines, including physical, chemical, biological, geological, and geophysical studies of the oceans and Earth.
Our impressive fleet of oceanographic research vessels is among the largest academic fleets globally. The Scripps Fleet includes the following:
R/V Roger Revelle: Our flagship global-class research vessel.
R/V Sally Ride: A cutting-edge ocean-class ship.
R/V Robert Gordon Sproul: A versatile regional-class vessel conducting short missions off the U.S. West Coast.
Both R/V Roger Revelle and R/V Sally Ride meet tonnage requirements for maintaining and upgrading unlimited licenses.
We are continually accepting applications for a per diem pool of candidates to be used on an "as needed" basis throughout the year for the following ships’ crew positions:
1st Officer (Title Code: 4306) Range: $52.16 - $75.98
2nd Officer (Title Code: 4307) Range: $47.05 - $68.55
3rd Officer (Title Code: 4308) Range: $41.91 - $61.06
Seaman (Limited or Unlimited) (Title Code: 4304) Range: $32.36 - $47.13
Ordinary Seaman (Title Code: 4305) Range: $25.00 - $36.42
Marine Cook and Sr. Marine Cook (Ordinary Seaman/Wiper Endorsement) (Title Codes 4300 & 4299) Range: $26.58 - $38.72 and $33.58 - $48.92
This posting will remain open as a pool for candidates throughout the year on an "as-needed" basis. Candidates will be contacted directly if a hitch opens up.

If you’re seeking a flexible, short-term opportunity that makes a difference and fuels your adventurous spirit, apply today! Join the per diem pool at Scripps Institution of Oceanography and be a vital part of our mission to explore and understand the world’s oceans.
Thank you for considering Scripps Institution of Oceanography as your next adventure. We look forward to welcoming you aboard!
To be considered for these exciting opportunities, candidates must meet the following requirements:
A valid U.S. Passport
Valid U.S. Coast Guard documentation and endorsements for the specific position, including:
Merchant Mariner Credential (MMC) with the following endorsements:
VPDSD Endorsement (Vessel Personnel Designated with Security Duties)
RFPNW/RFPEW (Ratings Forming Part of Navigational/Engine watch)
OICNW/OICEW (Officer in Charge of Navigational/Engineering Watch, for Officers ONLY)
Transportation Workers Identification Credential (TWIC)
Must be able to pass a pre-employment drug screen as a condition of employment.
Job offers are contingent upon successful completion of a background check.
